contentHtml:
A new 3D printer still in the box, or an existing one plagued by failed prints and layer shifts? I handle setup, careful calibration and repair around Stretton and Brisbane, so you get good prints more often and spend less time swearing at a spaghetti mess on the bed.

Setup, start to finish

  • Unboxing and assembly. Put together and set up correctly, so you are not guessing your way through a manual on day one.
  • Bed levelling and calibration. Proper bed levelling, Z-offset and flow-rate tuning, which is the single biggest factor in print quality.
  • Slicer setup. Your slicer of choice configured, Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio or another, with sensible starting profiles for your printer and filament.
  • First-print troubleshooting. Warping, stringing, layer shifting and adhesion problems diagnosed and sorted so your first jobs actually succeed.

Keeping it printing

A 3D printer needs the odd bit of upkeep, belts, nozzles and the occasional recalibration, and I can take care of that too, or show you how. If it is the computer and software side you are stuck on, see my software install and setup service.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
